title: Boris HTML-path build-report.json (v0.2)
description: Machine-readable twin of the HTML-path stderr text, written by `boris build --report PATH` and `boris validate --report PATH` on both success and failure. The prose contract in docs/contracts/diagnostics.md remains normative. Unlike the IR build-report it is flag-opt-in (no artifact is auto-written into the output tree); diagnostics cover all HTML-path classes including layout/theme. 0.2.0 adds the optional proofPack section (#741): when the run published target evidence and _boris/proof/checks.json could be read back, machine consumers see per-check verdicts in the same file instead of having to discover the separate evidence channel.

compilerId.description: Compiler id from the version constants (see docs/contracts/version.md); lets tooling pin the producing compiler.

ok.description: true iff the HTML build/validate succeeded with zero error diagnostics.

outDir.description: Configured HTML output directory (dist/ or --html-dir). validate writes the same value even though it publishes nothing.

proofPack.description: Publication-check verdicts mirrored from <outDir>/_boris/proof/checks.json. Present only when the run committed target evidence and the checks report was readable; absent for validate, pre-publication failures, and unreadable trees. A failing check never fails the committed target (docs/contracts/publication-checks.md); allPassed=false tells CI to inspect the findings[] array in that file.

allPassed.description: true iff no executed check reported status failed or incomplete.

diagnostics.description: Sorted diagnostics; see docs/contracts/diagnostics.md for the closed code set (including the ELAYOUT* family).

diagnostic.description: Key order: severity, code, message, remediation, sourcePath, line, column, id — identical to the IR diagnostic object.
